name: landing-page
title: Landing page
description: The marketing home page: TopNav, hero, logo cloud, feature grid, testimonial, CTA band, FAQ, site footer.

frame.summary: header → main(bands×n) → footer. No sidebar. The playground's shell minus its rail.

regions.name: header
regions.purpose: Brand, primary nav, Sign in / Start free actions.

budget.narrow: fill; nav items move into MobileNav

regions.collapse: TopNav items → MobileNav drawer behind a trigger, at the page's own narrow query.

regions.name: main
regions.purpose: The bands, full-bleed, each centring its own content.

budget.wide: fill (bands full-bleed; content capped per band)

dependsOnFuture.for: Hero, CTA band and footer are all blocked on it.

behavior.summary: Composition only. The template owns the outline, the landmarks and the one narrow media query that swaps TopNav items for MobileNav.

decisions.decision: Exactly one h1, in the hero
decisions.why: Every other band is an h2; the template passes headingLevel explicitly so the outline is reviewable in one place.
Separates bands without rules or cards; theme.bg.subtle has its own tone for exactly this (Avatar's contract records the change).

decisions.decision: The template owns the media query, blocks own none
decisions.why: TopNav and MobileNav both say they do not decide when they apply; the page does, as the playground does with NARROW.

landmarks.label: implicit; target of the skip link

obligations: First focusable element is a skip link to <main> — there is no skip-link component, so it is VisuallyHidden content that becomes visible on :focus-visible (open question: promote to a component).

steps.change: TopNav items → MobileNav; bands stack internally (their own container queries).

native.reason: A marketing landing page has no native equivalent; the app opens on its own home screen.

tokens.gap between bands: space.0 — each band owns its padding-block

tokenGaps.need: A page content max-inline-size (container width) for marketing bands
tokenGaps.interim: The band's content box is capped at calc(var(--rata-size-control-lg) * 32) and centred with auto inline margins; the playground's own column cap is a literal with a comment saying there is no measure token. Open decision: a size.container.* role via the design-tokens skill, or keep deriving from the control scale.

tokenGaps.need: A section-band vertical padding step larger than space.section for marketing rhythm
tokenGaps.interim: padding-block uses var(--rata-space-section) top and bottom. space.section is the only page-rhythm step and was sized for docs pages, not full-bleed marketing bands.

tokenGaps.need: Named breakpoints (narrow/medium/wide) as tokens or documented constants
tokenGaps.interim: The block is intrinsic (auto-fill grid, flex-wrap) and needs none. Where a step is unavoidable the page owns the query, as the playground owns its single 60rem NARROW query in use-media-query.ts.
Composed from visually-hidden; every template needs one, which is the argument for making it a component.

tokenGaps.need: A z-index / layer scale for the sticky header
tokenGaps.interim: The playground uses z-index: 1 with a comment; templates do the same until a layer token exists.
